author: /root/hair_ops
status: Proposed separately named evidence verifier; no publication or product source changes.
deterministic_transformation: build_successor.py requires the exact original SHA-256 and nine uniquely occurring source anchors. The bounded verifier rederives the successor byte-for-byte and parses its Python syntax. Only the three named object byte assertions, associated manifest reads, canonical master loading, a qualification helper and explicit output qualification are changed. All unrelated source bytes and assertions remain in place.
sample_scope: Seven bounded evidence inputs: three public reconstructed objects under their original-identity filenames, three untouched historical manifests, and the exact frozen crosswalk. No complete repository tree is copied.
historical_and_privacy_qualification: Original manifest identity, historical reader/revision context and original hash-labelled filenames remain historical references. New public bytes are separately hashed reconstructed evidence. A public-only run cannot verify withheld original bytes or infer checkpoint 3821. Existing Git history, archives, remotes and clones remain exposed.
integration_limit: The successor has not been executed end to end and the aggregate runner has not been changed. The runner currently invokes the original and also discovers verify_*.py; integration must choose the successor without also running the preserved original. Additional dynamic dependencies, compressed archives, historical Git objects, and other 059 raw-object exposures remain outside this bounded scope.
safety: No publication or earlier packet modification; no product execution, implementation, build, test or runtime probe; no full verifier execution or full-tree snapshot. Only evidence reconstruction and bounded verification.
